mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS couple_id, u.id AS user_id, u.name AS owner_name, u.role AS owner_role FROM couple c INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id IN (c.groom_id, c.bride_id) WHERE c.status = 'CONNECTED' AND (c.groom_id = #{userId} OR c.bride_id = #{userId}) AND u.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.id = #{userId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.id ASC

SELECT c.id AS card_id, cp.id AS card_product_id, cp.company AS company, COALESCE(c.card_name, cp.name) AS card_name, cp.image AS image, cp.annual_fee AS annual_fee, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cp.benefit, '$')) AS benefit, cp.`condition` AS condition_text, DATE_FORMAT(cp.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS condition_checked_at FROM card c INNER JOIN card_product cp ON cp.id = c.card_product_id WHERE c.id = #{cardId} AND c.card_product_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM card cd INNER JOIN couple co ON co.status = 'CONNECTED' AND (cd.user_id = co.groom_id OR cd.user_id = co.bride_id) WHERE cd.id = #{cardId} AND cd.card_product_id IS NOT NULL AND (co.groom_id = #{userId} OR co.bride_id = #{userId})
SELECT cp.id FROM card_product cp WHERE cp.company = #{company} AND cp.name = #{name} ORDER BY cp.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card_product ( company, name, annual_fee, image, benefit, `condition` ) VALUES ( #{source.company}, #{source.name}, #{source.annualFee}, #{source.image}, #{source.benefit}, #{source.conditionText} )
